tests.name: file_input_basic_parse
tests.intent: Probes basic JSON parsing from a standard FILE stream using the file input adapter.

tests.name: file_input_accept
tests.intent: Probes the accept() member function on a FILE stream to check valid and invalid JSON inputs.

tests.name: file_input_small_buffer
tests.intent: Probes file parsing with a very small buffer size set via setvbuf to test buffer-edge crossing.

tests.name: file_input_unbuffered
tests.intent: Probes file parsing with an unbuffered FILE stream (_IONBF).

tests.name: file_input_ungetc
tests.intent: Probes parsing from a FILE stream after characters have been pushed back via ungetc().

tests.name: file_input_cbor
tests.intent: Probes parsing CBOR binary data from a FILE stream across buffer boundaries.

tests.name: file_input_msgpack
tests.intent: Probes parsing MessagePack binary data from a FILE stream.

tests.name: file_input_ubjson
tests.intent: Probes parsing UBJSON binary data from a FILE stream.

tests.name: file_input_bjdata
tests.intent: Probes parsing BJData binary format from a FILE stream.

tests.name: file_input_sax_parse
tests.intent: Probes SAX-based parsing directly from a FILE stream.

tests.name: file_input_parse_error_token
tests.intent: Probes error messages and token carry mechanisms when parsing malformed JSON from a FILE stream.

tests.name: file_input_empty
tests.intent: Probes parsing an empty FILE stream to check error handling.

tests.name: file_input_whitespace_only
tests.intent: Probes parsing a FILE stream containing only whitespace characters.

tests.name: file_input_large_numbers
tests.intent: Probes parsing large numbers across buffer boundaries in a FILE stream.

tests.name: file_input_utf8_multibyte
tests.intent: Probes parsing multibyte UTF-8 characters across buffer boundaries from a FILE stream.

tests.name: file_input_nested_structures
tests.intent: Probes parsing heavily nested JSON arrays and objects from a FILE stream.

tests.name: file_input_escaped_strings
tests.intent: Probes parsing strings with various escape sequences crossing buffer limits in a FILE stream.

tests.name: file_input_allow_exceptions_false
tests.intent: Probes parsing with allow_exceptions set to false on a FILE stream input.

tests.name: file_input_callback
tests.intent: Probes parsing with a parser callback function on a FILE stream input.

tests.name: file_input_state_restoration
tests.intent: Probes that the FILE stream position is correctly left at the end of the JSON parse.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercises supports_bulk_scan and bulk_window via iterator/stream integration templates when parsed from FILE via explicit adapter concepts.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercises bulk_remaining returning 0 when current_in_buffer is false (e.g. before any character is buffered or when reading via fallback slow paths).

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercises supports_token_tracking and token segment marking when a token spans across buffer boundaries or falls back to slow path character fetching.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercises drop_last in copy_token during syntax error reporting where the last character of a token needs popping.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercises Apple platform specific FILE buffer pointer accessors (_p, _r, buffer_ptr, buffer_end, buffer_bump) via macro configuration or fallback paths when compiled on macOS/BSD environments.

tests.intent: Probes parsing from a FILE stream after characters have been pushed back via ungetc().

tests.name: file_input_escaped_strings_fixed
tests.intent: Probes parsing strings with various escape sequences crossing buffer limits in a FILE stream.

tests.intent: Exercises supports_bulk_scan and bulk_window via iterator/stream integration templates when parsed from FILE via explicit adapter concepts.
